newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MC-BBL says bullish on Hungarian share market.
newsitem.headline: MC-BBL says bullish on Hungarian share market.

text.p: London-based securities house MC-BBL said it was bullish on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE)'s outlook and expected further increase in the BUX index over the next year and a half.
"The BUX index is leading the charge for the east European stock indices," Mark Kane, analyst at the securities house, said in a technical analysis dated April 30 and received on Tuesday.
The BUX index soared to a new record level of 5,985.17 points on April 30 -- the last trading day in the previous week -- before retreating this week.
The analyst said many international investors were concerned that Wall Street might have reached its peak and if it fell this would negatively affect other stock markets.
"This is an understandable concern, but markets do not move completely in unison," Kane said.

"The BUX index is in the second stage of a three stage cycle that will lead the index higher over the next 18 months," he said. "Providing the index can hold above 5,750 points an advance of up to 15 percent could follow."
